lines.text: After Moses died, the LORD told Joshua to lead all the people across the Jordan into the land.
The LORD set Joshua's territory from the wilderness and Lebanon to the River Nile, and promised never to leave him.
The LORD told Joshua to observe all the law Moses commanded and meditate on it day and night.
Joshua told the officers to have the people prepare provisions, because within seven days they would cross the Jordan.
The Reubenites, Gadites and half-tribe of Manasseh promised to obey Joshua just as they had obeyed Moses.
